claims.statement: Tom Allen offered to fight Mike McCoole at any time, for any amount, and put $500 down on the counter as a forfeit; McCoole did not respond.

notes: Challenge was not accepted, so it is a challenge claim, not a fight. The second quote is McCoole's words with a line break in the OCR. Hint 1 is kept and says 'at any time'; the text says 'at any time, in a day or a week, and for any amount'.
